places.name: Old Man of Storr
places.ai_summary: A dramatic rock formation and one of the most iconic landmarks on the Isle of Skye, offering stunning views and hiking trails.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Wear sturdy shoes for the hike.
places.address: Old Man of Storr, Isle of Skye, United Kingdom

wikimedia_commons.source_file: File:Bodach an Stoir (The Old Man of Storr) - geograph.org.uk - 747492.jpg

attribution.title: Bodach an Stoir (The Old Man of Storr) - geograph.org.uk - 747492
attribution.author: John Allan
attribution.description: Bodach an Stoir (The Old Man of Storr) The 160ft tall pinnacle stands below the 600ft cliffs of the Storr itself. It is a distinctive landmark of Trotternish and is a noted seamark as well. It was formed along with many other rock formations as the sedimentary rocks below the basalt gave way under the weight above them and huge sections of the basalt face slipped downwards in a series of landslides.
